info.description: This API documentation provides details aboutEmad's Microfinance application, which offers comprehensive solutions for microfinance institutions (MFIs). The app includes features for managing member registrations, loan applications, savings, transactions, and more.

post.description: Runs the automatic check that cancels groups which have exceeded their scheduled duration. This is an administrative maintenance job and returns the number of groups that were cancelled as a result.

Scans all active groups and marks contributions that have passed their due date as overdue. Overdue members may be barred from upcoming draws (see missed-payment rules) while still owing their contributions. Returns the count of contributions updated.

get.description: Returns the eligibility snapshot recorded for a specific draw — the candidate pool with each member's eligibility flag and the reason they were eligible or excluded. This is the audit trail of who could have been selected in a given draw.

post.description: Approves a pending emergency draw request. Once approved, the requesting member is granted priority in the next draw selection so they can draw ahead of their scheduled position. A request can only be reviewed (approved or rejected) once.
Rejects a pending emergency draw request, typically because the reason or supporting evidence was not sufficient. A request can only be reviewed (approved or rejected) once.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Equb groups, optionally filtered by scheme (equb_scheme_id), lifecycle status (draft / active / completed / cancelled) or searched by name or code. Use this to manage all groups currently running or configured across the SACCO.

post.description: Creates a new Equb group under a given scheme. The group inherits its financial and membership rules from the scheme, and records an optional start date and expected end date. Groups are created in draft status and must be activated before members can cycle through rounds. A member can belong to at most one active group at a time.

get.description: Returns a single Equb group by its ID, including its inherited scheme details, current membership count and lifecycle status. Use this to review a group's configuration and progress.

put.description: Updates an existing Equb group's configuration, such as its name, code, expected end date or anonymity setting. Note that the financial values are inherited from the scheme and cannot be changed at the group level.

delete.description: Deletes (cancels) an Equb group by ID. Internally this calls the group cancellation flow. Only groups that are not actively cycling can be fully cancelled; an active group must have all rounds completed before its lifecycle can end.

post.description: Activates a draft Equb group by assigning a start date, which begins its round cycle. Members must join before activation. After activation the group is considered active, and members are bound to it until every round is complete (no early exit).

get.description: Returns an operational dashboard for a group with summary statistics and metrics, such as membership, round progress, contribution status and Takaful balance. Use this for an at-a-glance view of a group's health.

post.description: Cancels an Equb group, optionally recording a reason. A group that has already begun cycling should only be cancelled via the controlled cancellation flow, since members are committed to completing all rounds.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of emergency draw requests for a group, optionally filtered by status (pending / approved / rejected). Use this to review and track which members have been granted an early draw position.

post.description: Submits an emergency draw request so a member can draw ahead of their scheduled position due to exceptional circumstances, providing a reason and optional supporting evidence. The request is created in pending status and must be reviewed before it can take effect.
Extends an active Equb group by adding additional rounds beyond its original schedule. This increases the group's expected end date and total round count; members' commitment is extended accordingly.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of members in an Equb group, optionally filtered by their member status (active / suspended / inactive). Use this to review who is committed to a group and their assigned positions.

post.description: Adds a member to an Equb group and assigns them a position in the cycle. Membership is validated against group capacity and eligibility rules. A member cannot join if they already belong to another active group, and a group at full capacity rejects further members.
Swaps the draw positions of two members within a group. This affects the order in which members are selected for future draws.

delete.description: Removes a member from an Equb group. Important rule: a member of an active group cannot exit until every round is complete — the operation is rejected for active groups. Removal is only permitted while the group is still being assembled (draft).

post.description: Suspends an active member of a group. A suspended member is removed from draw eligibility but remains committed to the group and continues owing their contributions. This is useful for enforcing discipline when a member repeatedly misses payments or violates group rules.
Restores a previously suspended member of a group to active status, reinstating their eligibility for future draws (subject to the usual contribution and payment rules).

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the rounds for an Equb group, optionally filtered by round status (pending / active / collecting / ready_for_draw / drawn / paid / completed / cancelled). Each round represents one contribution-and-draw cycle with its own due date and payout.

Returns a paginated list of Takaful fund ledger entries for a group, optionally filtered by transaction type (contribution / claim / recovery / refund / surplus_distribution). The Takaful fund is funded by the per-member Takaful fee collected on top of each contribution.

Returns the current Takaful fund balance for a group. This is the mutual insurance pool built from the Takaful fees members pay on top of their contributions, minus any claims paid out. Note the balance is held separately from member contributions and winner payouts.

post.description: Submits a claim against the Takaful fund for a member of a group. The claim draws money from the group's Takaful balance. This is a ledger transaction against the fund and represents a genuine hardship/insurance payout, separate from the normal winner payout flow.

Distributes the remaining Takaful fund balance equally among the active members of a completed group. This settles the mutual insurance pool at the end of a successful cycle, crediting each member their share of any leftover surplus.

400.description: Group not completed or no balance to settle

post.description: Refunds the remaining Takaful fund balance equally among the active members of a group when the group is cancelled before completion. This settles the fund and returns each member their fair share of the leftover balance upon cancellation.
Approves a pending guarantee for a winner, advancing it from pending to approved. Guarantee approval is a required checkpoint before the corresponding winner's payout can be processed.
Rejects a pending equity guarantee for a winner. A rejected guarantee blocks the payout of that winner and resets their status so a new guarantee is required before any payout can be processed.

get.description: Returns a single Equb round by its ID, including its round number, scheduled date, contribution due date, total contribution collected, admin/Takaful fee totals, payout amount and current status.

post.description: Executes the draw for a round to select the round's winner(s) from eligible members using a secure random algorithm. The draw snapshots candidate eligibility (contribution paid, not suspended/overdue/proviously won) at execution time, records them, and returns both the draw record and the selected winners. Each winner's payout is ContributionAmt × MembersPerGroup.

get.description: Returns a preview of eligible and excluded members for a round's draw before actually executing it. A member is typically eligible only if their contribution is paid and they are not suspended, not overdue, and have not already won in the current cycle. Use this to verify fairness before running the draw.

Returns the list of winners selected for a specific round, including each winner's payout amount and their status in the payout lifecycle (selected → pending verification → approved → paid/failed). Use this to track who won and where each payout stands.

Returns a paginated list of Equb schemes, optionally filtered by lifecycle status (draft / active / completed / cancelled) or searched by name or code. Use this when managing the catalogue of scheme templates available to groups.

post.description:
Creates a new Equb scheme, which is the reusable template that configures every group's rules. The scheme defines the fixed contribution amount, the flat admin fee and Takaful fee that are added on top of each contribution, the payout a winner receives, the group size, and how many winners are selected per round.

Key business rules:
- The member pays ContributionAmt + AdminFee + TakafulFee each round; fees are NOT deducted from the contribution.
- The winner's payout must equal ContributionAmt × MembersPerGroup (payout math is validated).
- MembersPerGroup × WinnersPerRound determines membership and draw configuration.

get.description: Returns the full configuration of a single Equb scheme by its ID, including contribution amount, admin and Takaful fees, payout amount, group size, winners per round, contribution frequency and total number of rounds. Useful for reviewing the rules a group will inherit.

put.description: Updates an existing Equb scheme's configuration. Changes affect future groups created from this scheme; the same payout-math validation applies — the winner's payout must still equal ContributionAmt × MembersPerGroup. Editing fees (admin/Takaful) changes what each member pays per round for new groups.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an Equb scheme by its ID. Deletion is only meaningful for schemes that are no longer referenced by running groups; historical groups created from the scheme keep their already-captured rules.

post.description: Creates a guarantee for a winner before the payout can be processed. The guarantee can be member-backed, cheque, or collateral, and must be approved before the winner's payout proceeds. Guarantee type is one of member / cheque / collateral.

Processes the payout for a winner whose guarantee has been approved. The payout amount is the winner's payout (ContributionAmt × MembersPerGroup) and is issued through the existing payment system. Payout cannot be processed until the winner's guarantee is approved; after this the winner moves to paid.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of Equb groups owned by the current manager, optionally filtered by scheme, status or searched by name/code. Managers can then operate on their own groups via the manager-scoped routes.

Calculates the catch-up payment amount a member owes for the rounds they have missed in a group. This is the sum of missed contributions plus any associated fees they still have to settle. Managers use this to tell a member exactly how much they need to pay to become current.
Returns a paginated list of Equb schemes owned by the current manager, optionally filtered by status or searched by name/code. Managers only see and manage the schemes they created.

Returns the member's overall Equb balance summary across all their groups, combining outstanding contributions, paid amounts, and fees. Use this for the member's overall Equb balance / portfolio view.

post.description: Marks multiple contribution payments as paid in a single batch operation. Accepts a list of contributions; each is charged the contribution plus its admin/Takaful fees. Returns a per-item result so partially-failed batches can be reported back to the client.

get.description: Returns the member's Equb dashboard with an overview of their groups, contribution activity, and balance. Use this to power the main member dashboard view.

Returns a paginated list of Equb groups that are open for members to browse and join, optionally filtered by scheme, status or searched by name/code. Only public/active groups are exposed for self-service joining.
Returns a single Equb group by ID that is visible for members to review before joining, including its inherited scheme rules and current membership. Only public groups are returned.

post.description: Lets the authenticated member join an Equb group in the draw/position order. The member is validated for group capacity and eligibility — joining is rejected if the member is already in another active group or if the group is full. Once joined, the member is committed to the group for the full cycle.

400.description: Already a member or group is full

get.description: Returns the mobile-optimized home screen for the authenticated member, showing an at-a-glance summary of their active groups and upcoming commitments. This is the landing screen for the member's mobile Equb experience.
Returns the list of groups the authenticated member currently belongs to, with their status and role. Use this to render a member's
list.

Returns detailed information about a group the member belongs to — including the scheme's rules, the member's position, current round, and their standing in the group. Use this for the member's group detail screen.

post.description: Lets a member pay for multiple future rounds in advance in one transaction. The member chooses how many future rounds to prepay; each round is charged the contribution plus its admin/Takaful fees. Useful for members who want to get ahead of their schedule.

get.description: Returns detailed catch-up payment information for a member within a group — the rounds they missed, the number owing, and the total catch-up amount to settle. The member pays their missed contributions and associated fees to become current before the next draw.

Returns a paginated list of the current member's contributions within a group, optionally filtered by status (pending / paid / overdue / waived / catch_up). Each contribution shows the amount due plus admin and Takaful fees. Use this for the member's payment history.
Returns a paginated list of the members in one of the member's groups, optionally filtered by member status (active / suspended / inactive). Use this to show the member who else is in their circle.
Returns the member's position in the group's draw order and, where relevant, their expected winning round. Use this for the
view. After every active member has won once, the cycle may re-start for further rounds.
Returns a paginated list of rounds for one of the member's groups, optionally filtered by status. Use this for the member's round history / upcoming-rounds view.
Returns the rules and scheme details for one of the member's groups — contribution, fees, payout, frequency, and any group-specific settings. Use this for the member's
screen so they understand what they have committed to.

Returns the upcoming payment schedule for one of the member's groups — the future rounds, their due dates and the amounts due. Each payment is ContributionAmt + AdminFee + TakafulFee. Use this for the member's
view.

Returns a summary of the member's contributions for a group: how much has been paid, how much is outstanding (including any catch-up), and total paid in admin and Takaful fees. Use this for the member's balance / summary cards.

Returns the list of winners for a specific round in one of the member's groups, showing who won and the payout. Accepts the round via the required round_id query parameter. Use this to show the member who took each round's pot.

post.description: Marks a specific contribution as paid for the current member, referencing their payment in the payment system. The full amount due is ContributionAmt + AdminFee + TakafulFee (per the scheme). Use this as the single-contribution
action.

get.description: Returns the set of contextual quick actions available to the member for their active group(s) — such as paying the current contribution, viewing the schedule, or checking their position — so the mobile UI can render the most useful shortcuts.

Returns a paginated list of Equb schemes that are visible to members browsing available saving circles. Only schemes in active status are surfaced here; results can be filtered by status, or searched by name or code.

Returns a single Equb scheme by ID that is visible to members, showing the contribution amount, fees, payout, group size and frequency so a member can decide which circle to join. Only active schemes are exposed publicly.

Returns a paginated transaction history for the member across all their groups — paid contributions, payouts received, fees, and any Takaful activity. Use this for the member's full Equb transaction ledger.
Returns all of the member's upcoming payment dues across all their groups — the next contribution due for each group and its due date. Use this for the member's consolidated
view.
Returns the member's complete winning history across all their groups — each round they won, the group, and the payout received. Use this for the member's
screen. Note a member may only win again after the whole cycle of members has each won once (re-entry).
